text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain to host telecommunications conference on April 5. Around 45 countries to take part.
- Bahrain's Delmon Poultry Company posts drop in 1996 net profit to 358,859 dinars compared with 710,050 dinars in 1995.
- Secretary-General of the Gulf Cooperation Council had talks with Bahrain's Emir.
- More than 21 million dinars worth of property changed hands in the first quarter of 1996 in Bahrain.
